answer: What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit.
